cohort: 7,633 pregnant women recruited between 12 and 20 weeks of gestation in the Ottawa and Kingston Birth Cohort from 2002 to 2009
finding: Gestational hypertension and pre-eclampsia share common risk factors but may have different pathophysiology and mechanisms due to differences in effect sizes of risk factors and outcomes.
mod_finding: While gestational hypertension (GH) and pre-eclampsia (PE) share risk factors, the differing effect sizes of those factors and the association of PE with a wider range of adverse outcomes suggest distinct pathophysiologies.
